lines.english: "It's a pleasure to meet you. I'm Ogiso Setsuna."
"I'm sorry it took me so long to properly introduce myself. Still, I'm really happy that I finally get to meet Kazusa's mother in person."
"Ah, um, that's…"
"My name's Ogiso Setsuna. Please call me Setsuna."
"Then… nice to meet you, Setsuna-san. Um, about Kazusa… Thank you for constantly keeping an eye out for her, or perhaps I should say that I'm sorry for the trouble she's given you…"
"Not at all! I've been the one that's been troubling her, and since way back, too…"
"Ah, y-yes, umm… that's… hang on, Guitar-kun! What is the meaning of this!?"
"…Guitar-kun?"
"Ah, are you saying you're not feeling very well right now? If that's the case, we could just postpone this to some other time…"
"N-No, this is just cold sweat. My condition in itself is actually quite fine… I feel as if I've lost a couple of years, though."
It would seem that Youko-san and Setsuna's first meeting is proving to be an overwhelming victory for the latter.
In fact, Youko-san didn't even look this taken aback when she got the diagnosis on her illness…
"Ah, here's a gift from me… it's a moth orchid."
"T-Thank you… it smells lovely. It must've been expensive, huh?"
"You're not supposed to ask the price of a gift… Well, hehe, it was actually pretty cheap, though."
"I… I see…"
Youko-san is still unable to meet Setsuna's gaze; she instead tries to divert her attention to smelling the flowers.
I imagine that she hadn't expected that I would bring her along for this visit, much less the fact that I would bring her directly into her hospital room.
"I've heard about your illness. Perhaps this is a bit presumptuous of me, but I'll pray for you. So I hope that you'll do your best to recover… for Kazusa's sake as well."
In any case, given that everything Youko-san's done has been for Kazusa's sake, she doesn't really know much about Setsuna at all.
That's why it's probably difficult for her to digest the fact that Setsuna's right before her now, with a smile devoid of gloominess while saying these sincere words wishing her well…
"…Well?"
"Yes?"
"Are you two here to berate me?"
As I expected, Youko-san is now glaring at me as if asking for my help.
…In terms of how they express their feelings, they truly are mother and daughter.
"You've already talked to her about it, haven't you? About everything I've been doing for her up until now, that is."
"That's… correct."
"I see… so that's how it is. So that means you've chosen this girl."
"Youko-san…"
"I understand, Guitar-kun. I respect the decision you've made. …Congratulations."
Self-deprecation, resignation, and a regret that cannot be restrained…
"I'll do something about my daughter… about Kazusa. I won't bother you with her anymore."
The very person who had once told me that I've been too meddling and said that I've been carrying too much on my shoulders is now unconsciously blaming me for my sudden retreat.
They truly are mother and daughter, given the similarity in their choice of words and in how they behave around others…
"As I thought, I am starting to feel a little tired. I'm sorry, but I think it's best that you two take your leave…"
"Please wait!"
That's why Setsuna's decided to take the first step.
"Nothing's over yet! Kazusa… I just know I'll be able to do something about Kazusa!"
"Setsuna-san…?"
She's realized that the person before her is very similar to Kazusa. She feels that she's worth fighting for.
"So please listen to my proposal. I'm sure Touma Youko Office will take interest in what I have to say."
"Eh…"
"Allow me to introduce myself again. I'm Ogiso of Knights Records PLC."
"Touma Youko-san really is just as amazing as the rumors say. She was really overwhelming throughout our entire conversation."
"Still, unlike some other rumors, your mother is actually a really kind person who worries a lot about her child…"
"Is that so…"
"She missed you, you know? I suppose you haven't arranged a proper visit yet? If that's the case, we could go together tomorrow…"
"I won't go."
"Kazusa…"
"Oh, well. She said that she would be discharged by next week, anyway, so you could always visit her then."
"She looked quite healthy when I met her today, and she herself said that she's already feeling better, so I'm sure it'll all be alright, Kazusa."
"Alright…?"
"Yep, it'll all be alright! I'm sure someone like her will be able to overcome any illness she has."
"Ahaha… I suppose that did come off as a little rude. Still, she really does give off that kind of vibe, you know?"
"Ah, by the way, I see Youko-san calls Haruki-kun Guitar-kun, huh? Hey, is that something she picked up during the school festival…?"
"…Can you guarantee that?"
"Hmm?"
"Can you guarantee that?"
"Kazusa?"
"That my mom will always… that she'll live up until she's 100 years old?"
"That she'll make a complete recovery? That she'll take back what she said about retiring from playing the piano? That she'll go back to Vienna with me?"
"Can you promise that all that's going to happen, Setsuna? …On what basis can you claim that?"
"Kazusa…"
"Do you even understand? Can you really understand what all this means to me, Setsuna? …Do you know what it would mean for me to lose my mother?"
"Lose…? That isn't set in stone yet."
"You're surrounded by your family, and you can laugh with them, enjoy meals with them, have parties with them, and talk to them about anything that's troubling you…"
"How could you possibly understand the fear of losing my only family member with all that you have, Setsuna!?"
"Your attempts at consolation are completely lost on me. It only irritates me to be pitied by someone who has absolutely everything."
"Is that so…"
"Come on, Setsuna… that's enough already, isn't it?"
"I know that I'm in the wrong here. So just stop trying to condemn me in such a roundabout way, okay?"
"I'll let you hit me as many times as you want, so just hurry up and get out of my sight already."
"And don't ever come back here again…"
"I suppose so… You're right, I might just be wrong."
"If I found out my mother had been stricken with a terrible illness… I bet I'd cry my heart out together with my dad and Takahiro…"

"And we'd keep on crying as we'd talk about it all night, even if we wouldn't be able to come to a conclusion. But when the time would come for us to visit mom in the hospital, we'd do so with smiles on our faces. Our eyes would be bloodshot and red, but we'd desperately try to smile for her…"

"Despite the fact she'd know full well how bad her illness is by then, and despite the fact that we'd know about it all the same… I feel like we would all keep on trying to play the part of, in your own words, Kazusa, 'a family.'"
"…What are you even on about?"
"And maybe, just maybe, if that day should ever come… I'm sure that I'd feel as if it were the end of the world, just like how you're feeling right now, Kazusa."
"I'd feel sad, so sad, with my tears never stopping no matter how much I'd cry, and I wouldn't want to think about anything at all."
"If you really think so, then leave me alone…"
"But, for better or worse, it wouldn't actually be the end, you know?"
"Setsuna…?"

"We'd have to thank the medical staff that had been taking care of her, we'd have to consult the undertaker about where her funeral would be held… We'd have to reserve a funeral hall and contact all our relatives with the date of the wake and the funeral itself."

"And we'd be even busier on the day of the funeral itself, as we'd have to hear a word or two from each of our relatives and acquaintances that came… Then we'd have to make a list of everyone who attended the funeral to pay them back."
"…What are you trying to say?"
"I'd grieve really badly, you know? I'd really feel as though I wouldn't want to do anything. But even so, Iーweーsimply can't avoid having to connect with other people."
"And it's really more than just an unpleasant thing that we have to do."
"It's only through talking to other people that you'll be able to recover from the sadness that comes with the feeling that your whole world's been destroyed."
"And it's only when you're connected to others that, little by little, your world will start to heal."
"That's… only applicable to you, Setsuna. Things are different for me. I don't have anyone I can get close to."
"Yes, you do…"
"No, I don't! Once my mom is gone, there'll no longer be…"
"There's plenty of people around you that you can connect with, Kazusa. You simply never thought to look."
"No, there's no one left. I have no one left but my mother. And even she will end up leaving me before I know it…!"
"You do! I'm here!"
"…I don't."
"And you have Haruki-kun too!"
"Neither of you are with me, and I don't need either of you! The two of you are living in a completely different world from mine!"
"Kazusa!"
"Haruki has abandoned me. And you don't have any reason to stay by my side, Setsuna."
"I like you, Kazusa! Is me liking you not a good enough reason, Kazusa!?"
"…I see you still have that wonderful personality of yours, Setsuna. You think I'd ever believe such a convenient lie from you?"
"Why… do you have to think of it that way?"
"…Because I just know. I know just how filthy my own heart is."
"I fully believe that there's no one in this world that could ever come to care about someone as horrible as me!"
"But I do like you. I really do like you, Kazusa!"
"I don't believe you, I just don't. How could I ever!? There's no longer anyone who can promise to protect someone like me from the bottom of their heart!"
"There is someone here! And there's many more out there!"
"How could anyone even like such a horrible person like me!?"
"Who ever decided that it's impossible to like horrible people?"
"It's just impossible to like someone like that, isn't it!? After all… someone so deplorable… so cowardly…"
"Then why did you fall in love with Haruki-kun, Kazusa!? Someone so dishonest, deplorable and cowardly, why!?"
"Hey."
"What is it?"
"What in the world are you?"
"You're… asking me that? And not her?"
As Setsuna momentarily left to plant the flower she'd brought, Youko-san suddenly stared at me with a bewildered expression for some reason.
"Yes, you… What are you to have managed to gain the love of such an amazing girl?"
"Ah…"
In the end, what Youko-san truly wanted to know about wasn't about me, but about "that girl."
"I'm no one, really… I'm just an ordinary person. Setsuna just… has poor taste, that's all."
"Please don't criticize my own daughter's tastes with that statement."
"…Sorry."
"I understand now… Now I see why she felt that she was driven to the edge. She just doesn't stand a chance against that girl."
Despite the fact that I'm sure that statement was meant as a compliment, it ended up leaving quite the bitter taste in my mouth.
It's not embarrassment or humility. I actually agree with her deep down.
How in the world did I manage to end up with someone like her…?
"Well…? Was that presentation your idea?"
"…It was our idea. We spent almost a whole day thinking about it."
"I see… In a good and bad way, the two of you are really just unbelievable."
"I'm sorry."
Setsuna's presentation succeeded in surprising Youko-san, but it seems that it has yet to manage to convince President Touma to accept it.
Well, I suppose it's natural for her to want to think this through calmly.

The client which we're giving our proposal to is currently in the hospital. And the person who's giving that proposal hasn't really gone through any of the official procedures required; instead, he simply rode on the fact that Youko-san's the mother of her friend to push it upon her.
"Would someone usually go so far? For a girl you rejected… for a girl who's trying to take back the man she loves?"
"She's important to us…"
Even so, it's only through such aggressive measures that we're somehow capable of conveying our passion to her.
"Do you really intend to do this?"
"Yes."
"Do you intend to let that girl meet Kazusa, the way she is now?"
"I do… I think so, at least."
"Did she say she'd do it on her own accord? That's the girl who tried to steal her love, you know?"
"She's still her best friend, though. And she has been for five years… Though they separated once because of me."
"That's just the type of person Setsuna is."
Even though she's been betrayed by me countless times, even though she has cried countless times because of me.
And even though the reasons behind all that were all related to Kazusa…
And even though she must bear some ill will and guilt toward Kazusa… Even though she's harboring countless emotions within her, emotions too complex to be described with words alone.
Setsuna still wants to meet Kazusa despite all that. She's wishing that she'll be able to get Kazusa back on her feet again.
"Perhaps the victor's already been decided."
"I wonder about that… she hasn't exactly said that she's forgiven me, actually."
"Well, I know I personally wouldn't have forgiven you. I'd first make you go down on your knees and beg, then I'd just walk away and leave you like that."
"I… think so too."
I imagine only Kazusa would forgive me in such a scenario…
"Still, this is my daughter we're talking about here, so you know this won't be easy, right?"
"I understand that. We don't think that we'd be able to solve this just by meeting with her once or twice."
"But you might not even get another chance. I imagine that Kazusa will feel that there's no hope for her anymore the moment Setsuna-san arrives at her doorstep."
"That's why we need your cooperation, Youko-san. We need to create a situation where the two have to meet up with one another every day."
Setsuna said that she's not confident. That's why she said we have to keep trying, no matter how long it takes.
In that case, I have to create a scenario that will allow her to do that.
"Well then, I wonder what I should do about this? I do have some acquaintances within Knights… We did produce a CD once in the past."
"Yes, I know about that. The person responsible for that arrangement is now the president of the company Setsuna's working at."
"I see you've even looked up on how you'd manage to persuade me… you let nothing slip by you, now, do you?"
"My superiors have consistently reminded me that I can't rely on a single strategy if I want to work with Touma Youko Office."
"Still, even though she said that there'd be no losses, I actually don't see any merit in her proposal either."
"True, you did turn down our plan immediately after you learned that it involves the special issue of our magazine…"
"I wanted to increase her market value. Don't you think that it sounds a bit cheap for her first ever CD in Japan to be a bonus for a magazine?"
"In exchange, a lot more people will get access to it. And I'm certain that this will pave the way to Kazusa gaining a new fanbase."
"Do you think a mere music magazine will manage to sell that well?"
"Given Touma Kazusa's current popularity… I expect sales of this volume."
"What you're proposing won't actually get amazing publicity. …We'd need this amount, at least."
"Well, if we have to go that far, I'll need to ask for the final decision of my superiors. In any case, the only thing I can promise you right now is…"
"Get permission immediately then. You're not just an errand boy…"
"The company I'm working for would be able to handle that, but given that we'd be involving Knights Records this time…"
"Like I care about that. If you don't want me to turn down this plan of yours… promise me that you'll be able to produce this amount of sales right now!"
"Sorry to keep you… huh?"
"Well, I suppose I can buy some time and… that's it! That's the most I can promise you right now!"
"Oh, quit lying! You never had any rights to decide how many copies could be produced in the first place, now, did you?"
"If you know that, then stop making things difficult for me!"
"Hold on, don't get so excited now! What will you do if your blood pressure ends up rising?"
"You're the one… you're the one who doesn't understand anything, Kazusa. You have absolutely no idea how I've felt ever since that day!"
"…Setsuna?"
"Ever since you left… ever since you left everything unsettled between us… Do you know just how much I've worried, suffered and cried over it…!?"
"Don't shove the blame on me… none of that is my fault. And the fact that you and Haruki are so in love with one another is proof of that, isn't it!?"
"And for how long do you think we were apart before we came to this point!? How many times do you think we almost separated!? How many times do you think we almost gave up on each other!?"
"But you're still in love! And you two completely forgot about me!"
"Wrong! Haruki-kun never forgot about you! Not even once did he ever get over you, Kazusa!"
"Then why did he abandon me!?"
"Because you abandoned him for five years!"
"What!? Are you saying that this is all my fault!?"
"There's no other reason for it now, is there!? Everything happened because you were too cowardly!"
"…! Setsuna…? You're going that far? You, who now has everything you could ever want, are going to say all that to me, who's lost absolutely everything?"
"Stop being so selfish! You've always had his feelings all to yourself, so you have no right to even try to play the victim right now!"
"S-Setsuna…?"
"Aah, I… I…"
"Ugh… u-uuh…!"
"S-Sorry… um, I…!?"
"Wha…"
"Why didn't you just take him away…"
"Setsuna…"
"If you had only stayed in Japan, Haruki-kun would've belonged to you. So why did you end up running away…?"
"Because you… you took him from me…"
"That's right. I took him from you. …But you didn't say anything to me. You ran away without even putting up a fight."
"You gave me Haruki-kun back then. You gave up on Haruki-kun."
"That's, that's… that's…!"
"And yet you suddenly become like this over meeting him again after five years… I don't care if you've suddenly decided to change your mind about him now!"
"Shut up!"
"Coward!"
"Hypocrite!"
"Idiot!"
"Don't say it! Setsuna… Setsunaaaa!"
"You're an idiot, Kazusa! An idiot, idiot… an absolute idiot!"
"What's wrong with being an idiot!?"
"There's clearly something wrong with that!"
"…I'm sorry."
"…Why are you apologizing, Setsuna? It was my fault, after all."
"No, it was all my fault. I ended up provoking you all of a sudden."
"The one in the wrong is the person who started the fight."
"The person who lost their temper first is even more in the wrong."
"That's also because of my cowardice all this time."
"That's not true…"
"You said it yourself that it was my fault, didn't you…? Our fight, me hurting your face, me hurting your heart, it's all my fault…"
"…You're always like this, Kazusa."
"What are you talking about?"
"The fact that you keep convincing yourself that you're a bad person, and how you refuse to connect with other people and go straight to distancing yourself because of it."
"That's the sort of person I really am, and there's nothing I can do about it. I'm gloomy, reclusive, and only capable of being jealous of others…"
"Like I said, why do you decide that on your own…?"
"Because it's the truth."
"You're wrong… you're really not that kind of girl, Kazusa. You're kind, sensitive, and you're a wonderful person who's always considerate of others."
"I know myself better than anyone else. I don't need an outsider to make any unsolicited comments about who I am."
"An outsider…? Why are you putting it that way…?"
"An outsider is an outsider, or are you aspiring to be my mother or something?"
"Again, why do you keep trying to act out on purpose? Even though you're just going to regret it right after saying stuff like that!"
"I'm not going to regret a single thing! You're the one that's trying to decide who people really are, Setsuna…"
"What's with that!?"
"What's up with you!?"
"…I'm sorry."
"…Why are you even apologizing, Setsuna? It was my fault, after all."
"How many times do we have to go through this…"
"Until you never come back here again."
"…I've been telling you from the start, haven't I? I can't go back to my company until I finish my work with you. I can't leave your side until that happens."
"Then I'll lodge a complaint to your superiors and have them fire you."
"If it comes to that, I'll just have your president mediate the situation. I'm sure she'll stand up for me."
"Hey, Setsuna."
"What?"
"You really do hate me, don't you?"
"I like you… I really like you, Kazusa."
"So how did we end up like this…? That's a question I've been asking myself for the last five years."
"Setsuna…"
"Like, dislike, love, hate… is our relationship not simple enough to be described with words like that?"
"Like I'd know."
"I suppose…"
"…Go home already. You have work tomorrow, don't you?"
"Should I even be going with my face being the way it is…?"
